ayahOccurrences.text: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَرْتَعْ is in the derivative form: يَرْتَعُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ر/ت/ع   r–t–ʿ to pasture in lush grass, to be in fertile land, to have plenty to eat and drink, to live in great affluence; to lark about in a carefree manner. Of this root, يَرْتَعُ yartaʿ occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَرْتَعُ yartaʿ [imperf. of v. رَتَعَ rataʿa, intrans.] to enjoy oneself playing in the open, to run about enjoying oneself

(12:12) أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ send him with us tomorrow to run about and play.
